description: Implementation of the Network Management (Nm) module for AUTOSAR, including initialization, network requests, state management, and interaction with bus-specific NM layers like CanNm, FrNm, and LinNm.

methods.name: Nm_Init
methods.description: Initializes the NM interface with provided configuration.

methods.name: Nm_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Returns version information of the NM module.

methods.name: Nm_PassiveStartUp
methods.description: Calls bus-specific passive startup functions based on channel configuration.

methods.name: Nm_NetworkRequest
methods.description: Requests network communication on a specified channel.

methods.name: Nm_NetworkRelease
methods.description: Releases network communication on a specified channel.

methods.name: Nm_DisableCommunication
methods.description: Disables NM communication on a specified channel.

methods.name: Nm_EnableCommunication
methods.description: Enables NM communication on a specified channel.

methods.name: Nm_SetUserData
methods.description: Sets user data for NM messages to be transmitted.

methods.name: Nm_GetUserData
methods.description: Retrieves user data and node ID from the last received NM message.

methods.name: Nm_GetPduData
methods.description: Retrieves the PDU data of the last received NM message.

methods.name: Nm_RepeatMessageRequest
methods.description: Sets the repeat message request bit for the next NM message.

methods.name: Nm_GetNodeIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the node identifier from the last received NM message.

methods.name: Nm_GetLocalNodeIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the local node identifier.

methods.name: Nm_CheckRemoteSleepIndication
methods.description: Checks for remote sleep indication (stub implementation).

methods.name: Nm_GetState
methods.description: Gets the current state and mode of the network.

methods.name: Nm_NetworkStartIndication
methods.description: Indicates that a NM message has been received in sleep mode.

methods.name: Nm_NetworkMode
methods.description: Indicates that the network has entered normal mode.

methods.name: Nm_PrepareBusSleepMode
methods.description: Indicates preparation to enter bus sleep mode.

methods.name: Nm_BusSleepMode
methods.description: Indicates that the network has entered bus sleep mode.

methods.name: Nm_PduRxIndication
methods.description: Indicates reception of an NM message.

methods.name: Nm_StateChangeNotification
methods.description: Notifies a change in NM state.

methods.name: Nm_MainFunction
methods.description: Periodic processing function for NM.
